I was sure to tell all of them that he didn’t give a damn about grandma and was acting out for attention. People gave me the cold shoulder for the rest of the evening. They told me to have compassion because I am the older sibling. I think he’s an asshole and being an attention whore. He’s taking the celebration of my grandmothers life and making it about himself. Who is the asshole here?
